content.short: WhatsABI is a web app for guessing ABIs from an address via 4-byte JUMPI instructions.
content.description: WhatsABI reveals the ABI of a Solidity smart contract from its address, even when the contract isn’t registered. Developers can query the contract’s events, interfaces, selectors, and database loaders directly, enabling thorough inspection and integration from a single address. The tool supports Ethereum and compatible networks, including Arbitrum, Avalanche, and BNB Chain, empowering engineers to validate interactions and build applications without requiring a prepublished ABI. This streamlines contract analysis and integration across multi-chain projects.
